title: Light and Crumbly Mediterranean Wrap
description: A light, crumbly Mediterranean bread flour wrap made without eggs, perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add water and olive oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Brush the circles with olive oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake the wraps in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Let the wraps cool on a wire rack before serving.
